issues.subject: From London: Porto £48 return, plus a day in Ghent
issues.text:
Window Seat · {date}

From London: Porto £48 return, plus a day in Ghent

Fares checked at 06:40 on 22 October, from London, with one bag that fits under the seat. I've included the flights I actually found at each price.

Porto from Gatwick, £48 return
I found this for Tuesday 17 to Saturday 21 November, out just after lunch and back at 17:20. The same flights a week later were £56. Both totals are for a small bag, and the price jumped to £89 when I added the larger cabin bag in both directions. The outbound lands at an hour when you can still take the metro into town and get something to eat.
https://windowseat.example/fares/porto-gatwick-november

Bologna from Stansted, £57 return
The Friday departure gets in at 22:05, which is late enough that I'd check with your accommodation before booking. There's a £61 combination that goes Thursday evening and comes back on Sunday afternoon. I've kept both sets of flights in the fare note. The coach fare to Stansted on my sample dates accounted for a decent share of the saving compared with going from Gatwick.
https://windowseat.example/fares/bologna-stansted-december

A day in Ghent from St Pieters
Get the tram into town and walk the last bit from the river at Koophandelsplein. You can spend most of the afternoon within ten minutes of the bridge at Graslei. I liked the walk up to Prinsenhof late in the day, when the bigger tour groups had gone. Leave time for the tram if you're picking up an evening train, especially if you have to collect your bag first.
https://windowseat.example/guides/ghent-on-foot

Until Thursday,
Nell Armitage, editor

Window Seat · 38 Rookery Mews, London E8 4AP

issues.subject: Tallinn £72 return and the slow side of Turin
issues.text:
Window Seat · {date}

Tallinn £72 return and the slow side of Turin

This week's two fares are for midweek departures. The Turin walk starts in a market, with enough time to get out before the stalls pack down.

Tallinn from Luton, £72 return
The £72 was Monday to Thursday in the second half of November. The flight out leaves at 07:05. Check what you'll spend on a train, coach or cab at that hour before committing. I found a Tuesday option for £84 that leaves after breakfast. The sample search includes those two pairs side by side, along with a note on the bag size used to get each total.
https://windowseat.example/fares/tallinn-luton-midweek

Aarhus from Stansted, £63 return
Tuesday evening out, Friday afternoon back. The £63 total came up across two consecutive weeks. The airport is some way out and the connecting bus makes a difference to how much of Friday you'll have in town. I checked a later return on Sunday and the fare was nearly double. It's worth making Tuesday to Friday work if you can take the time, or looking at Billund as well.
https://windowseat.example/fares/aarhus-stansted-midweek

Turin before the shops shut
At Porta Palazzo it's easy to spend all your time in the outside market. I went into the hall on the north side when it started to rain and came out with lunch in a paper bag. From there it's a short walk to the Dora. Take the riverside path west if you have forty minutes left. I've marked where I turned inland to get back to my tram.
https://windowseat.example/guides/turin-porta-palazzo

Until Thursday,
Nell Armitage, editor

Window Seat · 38 Rookery Mews, London E8 4AP

issues.subject: Winter seats to Marseille, a morning in Utrecht
issues.text:
Window Seat · {date}

Winter seats to Marseille, a morning in Utrecht

This edition needs a little patience with the fare calendars. Both routes have dips of a day or two at a time. I've put my sample weekend prices alongside the cheaper ones.

Marseille from Stansted, £51 return
The two £51 fares I found left on a Wednesday and came back Saturday morning. For another £9 you could come back Saturday evening and have most of that day in town. The airport bus dropped me at the upper level of Saint-Charles last time. If you're continuing by train, allow a few extra minutes to work out which entrance takes you to your platform.
https://windowseat.example/fares/marseille-stansted-winter

Krakow from Gatwick, £66 return
There's a late Wednesday flight and a Saturday return at lunchtime. Compare the price with the Gatwick train before you pick a route. One Wednesday I checked had a base fare under £30 and a train to the airport for almost the same amount. The fares in my table are for one passenger. When I looked for three seats together, the cheapest pairing disappeared.
https://windowseat.example/fares/krakow-gatwick-winter

Utrecht before the day gets busy
Come in through the station's east exit and go across the square before you turn towards the water. I went down the first set of steps to the lower canal path and had it to myself for a few minutes. Once the delivery bikes arrive it's nicer up at street level. I've marked a loop that gets you from the station and back within an hour without hurrying.
https://windowseat.example/guides/utrecht-first-train

Until Thursday,
Nell Armitage, editor

Window Seat · 38 Rookery Mews, London E8 4AP

issues.subject: Bergen £69 and a hillside afternoon in Lisbon
issues.text:
Window Seat · {date}

Bergen £69 and a hillside afternoon in Lisbon

One early departure this week. If you go for it, check which of the two airport buses comes from your side of town. They leave from different streets.

Bergen from Gatwick, £69 return
The low fare was a Sunday departure and a Wednesday return. The 08:05 Sunday flight is the one that makes it work. Check the first train from your station if you're going via London Bridge. I priced the next departure at £105 return. If you need a full-size cabin bag on both legs, the gap narrows because the two flights do different things with baggage.
https://windowseat.example/fares/bergen-gatwick-short-break

Nantes from Stansted, £46 return
I found seats out Monday afternoon and back Thursday morning with enough space for a small rucksack under the seat. The Thursday leg is early enough that I'd stay in the centre and check the airport shuttle timetable at the stop the night before. A Friday evening flight was £21 more in the search. The city centre walk in the fare notes ends at a tram station.
https://windowseat.example/fares/nantes-stansted-midweek

Lisbon: up from the water
Start beside the ferry terminal and take the flatter river stretch towards Santa Apolonia. The uphill part is short, with three benches on the way, but the stones at the first turn were slippery after rain. At the top I stopped at a small grocery before walking back down past the tram junction. The route notes mark where you'll first see the river again.
https://windowseat.example/guides/lisbon-up-from-the-water

Until Thursday,
Nell Armitage, editor

Window Seat · 38 Rookery Mews, London E8 4AP

issues.subject: Luxembourg after work, Antwerp before lunch
issues.text:
Window Seat · {date}

Luxembourg after work, Antwerp before lunch

Two Friday flights made it into the sheet this week. I also used up almost an hour in Antwerp station without minding terribly.

Luxembourg from Stansted, £54 return
Out Friday at 18:55, back Sunday shortly after lunch. That second leg is the one that has room at this price. The £54 uses the smallest bag allowance. I found Sunday evening seats if you want the whole day, though the fare rose to £93. My table has the two different arrival times so you can match them to a reasonable way home from Stansted.
https://windowseat.example/fares/luxembourg-stansted-friday

Cork from Luton, £47 return
The low price was Friday evening to Monday just before noon. A Sunday return cost £32 more for the dates I tried. If you're seeing someone in town, the later Friday flight leaves a decent stretch of evening once you're there. I used the bus from right outside arrivals last time. It was easier to have the stop name written down before I got on.
https://windowseat.example/fares/cork-luton-friday

Antwerp with a station start
If you arrive on the lower platform, go all the way to the top before you leave the building. The views across the stairs change at every level. Outside, head to the square from the front and cut over towards the old botanical garden. There's a bookshop halfway round with a bench by the door, which is useful if you've got luggage and one person wants to browse.
https://windowseat.example/guides/antwerp-station-loop

Until Thursday,
Nell Armitage, editor

Window Seat · 38 Rookery Mews, London E8 4AP

issues.subject: £55 to Gdansk, a walk round Ljubljana
issues.text:
Window Seat · {date}

£55 to Gdansk, a walk round Ljubljana

The departures below are late enough for a train from home. I checked them on one small bag and no reserved seat.

Gdansk from Luton, £55 return
This was Tuesday late morning to Friday early evening. I also found a Sunday flight out at a similar price, but it landed hours later and the return was over £90. If you want all three nights in town, double-check which date the flight actually lands. The fare notes show both arrival times in local time and the station name to look for at the airport.
https://windowseat.example/fares/gdansk-luton-late-start

Basel from Gatwick, £64 return
There were midday seats in both directions on my Wednesday to Saturday search. When we flew it last year, two people in our group went out of arrivals into France by mistake. Follow the signs for the right side if someone is meeting you. The city bus I used was from the Swiss side. My sample dates and the later Saturday departures are linked above the comparison table.
https://windowseat.example/fares/basel-gatwick-late-start

Ljubljana from the market to the park
Get to the covered market early on a Saturday if you like seeing the stalls while they're still setting up. I took my coffee across the river and looped north towards the park. The first path under the railway was open, but the second one on my map came to a fence. I've marked the crossing I ended up using and the quiet way back towards the bus station.
https://windowseat.example/guides/ljubljana-market-park

Until Thursday,
Nell Armitage, editor

Window Seat · 38 Rookery Mews, London E8 4AP
